read_summary: user-provided Opus session summary (local-only source, not included in repository)
scope: Existing frozen final-LN DINOv3 unit q/r tokens and one complete reference coverage; NumPy/SciPy CPU; no query GT, score host, new encoder, SSH, downloads or new models.
readout_contract: Episode->Result complete signed native query margin; margin>0 foreground and margin=0 background. Shared physical64 bilinear->work1024 strict>0->original binary renderer. All controls use identical renderer. Invalid padding is excluded from statistics and emits zero margin.
not_proposed: A different bandwidth, kernel order, rank, threshold or parameter is not another method.
A generic density, ridge, Gaussian, EM, transport, query whitening or score-prior rewrite is not automatically new.
No real segmentation benefit is established by these cards or the four legal-input observations.
The missing 11 slots are intentional; quality and distinctness take priority over filling the group quota.

cards.title: 逐图通道秩的单调域变换不变量
cards.gap: When the same semantic ordering survives but a query image applies a channel-wise monotone feature warp, raw cosine/prototype comparisons can put all query target features on the reference-background side. The current ledger shows a large reference-to-query signature gap but does not establish that monotone warps explain it.
cards.history_evidence: Summary 3.10-3.11 and RESULTS.md:1548-1582 show large transfer loss, ordinary reference cues fail on hard queries, and covariance whitening/CORAL/mean shift are negative. These concern a different moment/metric correction; they give no positive evidence for this candidate.
cards.available_information: Each fixed DINO feature channel's unlabeled empirical marginal order in the supplied R and Q; R foreground/background weights. Four local RGB128 native packs have 64 tokens x1024 channels. Per-channel robust span Q/R median ratios are 0.982-1.088, an availability observation only, not proof of monotone semantic transfer.
cards.new_observation_or_argument: Algebraic: empirical channel ranks are unchanged by any strictly monotone increasing coordinate transform applied separately to R or Q, if no ties or membership/composition change. Hence the decision can differ from raw cosine without estimating a covariance nuisance. Channel-wise monotone transfer with differing target fractions is unverified and may break it.
algorithm: Use all valid R rows, known soft FG/BG weights; compute normalized per-channel midranks in R and independently in Q.
Replace constant channels by rank0.5; normalize rank to (rank+0.5)/N.
Compute weighted FG and BG mean rank vectors using supplied coverage and valid-minus-FG weights.
Score every Q token by squared distance to BG rank mean minus squared distance to FG rank mean, divided by the positive sum of the two distances.
Emit Result(margin) as the complete signed query native-grid score and use the shared strict>0 renderer.
Empty FG gives all-negative margin; no BG uses common all-foreground prototype degeneracy; equal rank centroids give exactly0 so fixed strict cut returns background. Invalid Q padding emits0.
cards.expected_benefit: algebraic/synthetic_witness pending: recover target ordering under the specified monotone domain-warp construction where raw prototype margin fails. Natural DINO segmentation gain unknown; no numerical prediction.
cards.simplest_control: Raw weighted FG/BG prototype margin and raw FG cosine with identical outputs; per-image coordinate z-score prototype control separates ordinal nonlinear invariance from mere centering/scaling. Same marginal ranks under an orthogonal feature rotation tests its coordinate-dependent assumption.
cards.why_not_duplicate: No class-prior estimation, no query score, no second moments or inverse covariance, no query seed/self-training. The complete decision compares image-specific ordinal positions; raw and z-score cosine can change under nonlinear marginal warps while the rank decision is unchanged. This is one encoding/decision method, not multiple rank/bin variants.
cards.counterexample: If query target prevalence differs from reference or a new background mode changes marginal ranks, rank positions change although raw semantic features are unchanged. DINO basis rotations also alter the per-channel quantity; it is intentionally coordinate dependent.
cards.first_evidence: Construct unit-circle R/Q feature tables with identical role ordering and a monotone angle warp causing prototype reversal; prove ordinal decision unchanged and compare raw/z-score controls. Negative query-prevalence shift and orthogonal rotation. Then fixed complete output on all4 native RGB128 inputs, only activity/cost (QGT unavailable), no gain claim.
cards.cpu_cost: NumPy sorting O(D*(Nr log Nr+Nq log Nq)), storage O(D*(Nr+Nq)); process Q ranks one channel block at a time. One CPU thread;64-token actual probes small. For4096x1024 input, approximately67MiB float64 working matrices; no dense4096x4096 Gram required.
cards.limitations: Image composition is part of the empirical CDF and can invalidate invariance. Unit normalization after a hypothetical coordinate warp can also destroy coordinate monotonicity; claim is only for the observed normalized-coordinate warp. Not rotation invariant. Four native128 views do not establish native1024 quality. Failure reflection: distinguish composition-induced rank shift from an absent monotone transfer model by fixed synthetic negatives and real rank/prototype disagreement, without query labels or parameter sweep.

evidence_levels.real_segmentation_gain: measured real native1024 four reused cases; no stable positive overall benefit
evidence_levels.synthetic_witness: measured constructed positive and counterexample; not natural quality

cards.probe_reflection: Initial affine-angle fixture was equally solved by zscore and is retained. Fixed nonlinear monotone angle fixture gives6/6 ordinal,5/6 zscore,3/6 raw prototype. Query-prevalence negative reverses advantage. Algorithm was unchanged between fixtures.
cards.quality_claim_status: fixed complete quality claim closed after200; keep useful component actions, do not open cut/CDF variants

cards.title: 参考类内支持半径校准的局部距离判别
cards.gap: Raw nearest-reference labels compare absolute distance, so a narrow FG appearance mode and a broad BG mode can be treated as equally transferable. A query may lie nearer a compact FG anchor in absolute angle yet be many FG radii away and remain within ordinary BG variation.
cards.history_evidence: Summary3.11 reports cross-image local matches often absent. RESULTS.md:1202 and:1579-1582 reject ordinary reference nearest-neighbor margin on residual errors. Prior fixed RBF class density, convex hull and query prior-shift were negative. This candidate must show a local scale decision beyond those fixed controls; merely choosing k or bandwidth does not count.
cards.available_information: Reference role-labelled local feature distances; no Q-density or predicted class share. On local pure-role reference tokens, nearest-role radii vary2.52-4.47x across anchors; two packs have no coverage>=0.9 FG token. Heterogeneity is observed, cross-image transfer of these local scales is not.
cards.new_observation_or_argument: The absolute nearest-distance decision and the normalized local-support decision need not agree even with the same FG/BG means and query positions. Candidate hypothesis: reference local appearance dispersion is a useful rejection scale, rather than assuming all nearest anchors equally reliable. This is not semantic confidence or a calibrated posterior.
algorithm: Select full-patch absolute FG mass wf>=0.9 and BG mass wb>=0.9 with wf<=0.1, wvalid>=0.9; not conditional wf/wvalid purity. Use at most256 uniformly selected spatial row IDs for both roles and all matched controls.
If either class has fewer than3 selected rows, use the common raw FG/BG prototype margin and record inactive/fallback.
Within each class let k=min(n-1,ceil(sqrt(n))); set each anchor's h to its kth nonself squared Euclidean distance.
Zero-radius anchors use the smallest positive class radius; a completely identical class uses exact-match support only (nonmatches cost+infinity).
For every Q row define d_class=min_anchor ||q-r_anchor||²/h_anchor.
Compare BG versus FG normalized costs using (dBG-dFG)/(dBG+dFG), with finite deterministic limits if infinity.
Emit signed Result(margin) with complete shared renderer; ties and invalid Q padding remain0.
cards.expected_benefit: hypothesized: delete false targets that win raw nearest matching only because a compact class has an unusually close isolated anchor; synthetic positive must establish this action. May lose shifted true targets, so no natural gain prediction.
cards.simplest_control: Raw FG cosine, raw FG/BG prototype and raw nearest-class distance; single role-global radius distance control; role-balanced fixed-kernel density control under the same selected tokens and same render. The local-radius arm must alter a decision beyond these controls to justify distinctness.
cards.why_not_duplicate: The tested new assumption is heteroscedastic local support rather than means, a single Gaussian covariance, convex combination feasibility or target proportion. If reviewer finds this a bandwidth-only density revision, count_delta remains0; four radii choices are not four methods.
cards.counterexample: Broad clutter modes can acquire huge radii and become easy BG explanations, deleting genuine shifted target features. A singleton rare FG mode gets no transferable scale. Reference-only local radii need not predict a different image's semantic displacement.
cards.first_evidence: Unit angular-feature table with identical raw closest-class decision but unequal class dispersion; require a complete false-target deletion and same-info global-radius/kernel controls. Reverse query style shift must show the expected target-deletion failure. Actual4 probes must explicitly report that packs1/2 fallback for no pure FG; no mIoU inference.
cards.cpu_cost: Bound each class anchor bank to256 deterministic spatially uniform selected rows for full grids; same subsampling in every control. O((NrFG²+NrBG²)*D+Nq*NrAnchors*D), chunk queries32; one thread, under64MiB distance workspace. Approx1.1e9 products at4096x512anchorsx1024, cost must be measured before claiming latency.
cards.limitations: Pure-reference requirement fails in2/4 actual128 packs. Adapting radii cannot fix identity ambiguity when both role supports explain the same target. Not probability calibration. Failure reflection compares deletions versus additions and whether a broad BG mode absorbed target candidates; without QGT only mechanisms and output activity can be determined.

evidence_levels.real_segmentation_gain: measured real native1024 four reused cases; no stable positive overall benefit
evidence_levels.synthetic_witness: measured constructed positive and counterexample; not natural quality

cards.pure_role_definition: Strict full-encoder-patch mass: FG requires wf>=0.9 and wvalid>=0.9; BG requires wb=wvalid-wf>=0.9, wf<=0.1 and wvalid>=0.9. This is stricter than conditional physical c=wf/wvalid purity, intentionally excluding neutral-padding contamination. No quality/coverage guarantee.
cards.quality_claim_status: fixed version closed; do not expand200; keep callable negative method and failure evidence

cards.title: 保留类内语义切向量的有向仿射支持
cards.gap: A target's same-class variation can move outside the convex hull of the supplied reference features. Prototype distances may penalize this variation, while a convex hull forbids extrapolation. The unresolved question is whether a lawful signed reference tangent can explain the move without amplifying nuisance directions.
cards.history_evidence: Current PLAN records reference hull public60048.915 and covariance12.343; RESULTS.md:1565-1577 records CORAL/mean-shift failure and only19-27% signature motion in query leading directions. Summary3.11 shows whitening damages semantics. These are direct risks; tangent transfer is unknown, not a rebuttal of the negative results.
cards.available_information: Weighted FG/BG class means and centered reference residual directions, from complete legal R coverage only. On pure-role packs0/3, leading2 reference residual directions carry51-63% of role variance. This is genuine finite source variation, not proof it corresponds to cross-instance semantic motion.
cards.new_observation_or_argument: A signed affine plane has directions outside a convex hull and differs from a class Gaussian metric: the proposed cost projects away up to2 observed high-variance tangent directions rather than inverting covariance or amplifying low variance. A unit spherical extension witness can distinguish this from raw prototypes and convex hull; degeneracy to a Gaussian-subspace revision must be adjudicated by reviewer.
algorithm: For each role compute coverage-weighted mean mu and centered weighted residual matrix from all valid R tokens.
Obtain at most2 nonzero right singular vectors U per class; retain all others unchanged (no whitening, no Q covariance).
For each Q token compute residual e=q-mu and orthogonal squared residual cost ||e||²-||Uᵀe||².
Add a fixed one-sided pole penalty max(0,-q·unit(mu))², so the antipodal direction cannot be declared same class solely through span membership.
Compare FG/BG costs with normalized signed difference and emit field0.5+0.5*margin.
A zero-rank class uses its prototype squared distance; empty FG yields background, missing BG falls back to common raw FG cosine.
Shared fixed renderer completes the query mask; no ROI, query seed, or region posterior enters.
cards.expected_benefit: hypothesized: recover appearance changes along a reference-supported semantic tangent while retaining orthogonal background differences. No evidence yet that actual semantic signature motion lies in this class tangent, and no mIoU prediction.
cards.simplest_control: Common raw FG cosine/prototype, same-rank global reference tangent projection, and class tangent disabled. On witness, compare exact convex hull support and class diagonal/full Gaussian metric with the identical samples; no different render or parameter sweep.
cards.why_not_duplicate: Unrestricted signed within-class extrapolation differs from convex nonnegative hull reconstruction; keeping the orthogonal residual differs from inverse covariance matched filtering. It is a single fixed rank2 geometry, not a rank sweep. If its complete decision is judged a low-rank Gaussian/hull revision, do not count it independently.
cards.counterexample: Same-class tangent may be scene variation; it may intersect background support and make identity less discriminative. A curved manifold outside a linear tangent fails. Reference BG often has much higher rank than FG; fixed equal rank can bias the decision.
cards.first_evidence: Build finite unit-vector source samples and query extension along an observed FG tangent beyond the FG convex hull, with orthogonal BG. Require full-mask success versus prototype/hull/global-tangent controls. Negative intersecting-class tangent and tangent-as-background-change. Run actual4 full outputs, record residual energy and activity, not quality.
cards.cpu_cost: For4096x1024 source, select at most256 weighted spatially uniform rows per role (matched across controls), thin SVD via source Gram <=256x256; O(D*256²+D*Nq*4), memory<32MiB per role. One thread, no NxN query graph.
cards.limitations: Reference tangent transfer unobserved; full natural128 evidence not1024. A small pure-source tangent observation does not establish coverage-weighted full-reference usefulness. Algebra can establish representation distinction only. Failure reflection identifies whether orthogonal residual support is too broad, tangent transfer absent, or asymmetric role rank dominates, without automatically opening another rank.
cards.closure: src/ics/methods/reference_hull.py already contains span_distance(..., affine=True) and affine_control role-specific signed nullspace distances. Rank2/pole restriction insufficient to create independent method.

cards.title: 参考角色的非因子化通道共现编码
cards.gap: A single prototype and any first/second-moment classifier lose distinctions encoded in a joint feature pattern with identical low-order marginals. A third-order binary parity is a decidable example; it is not evidence that DINO's real errors have this structure.
cards.history_evidence: Current PLAN records fixed directional quadratic kernel51.607, covariance12.343 and spatial three-token relation60.779 versus MEAN62.932. These are negative on processed cache pipeline. This construction uses co-occurrence of3 feature coordinates within one token, not spatial roles of3 tokens, and must show a decision not already supplied by the quadratic control.
cards.available_information: Frozen DINO coordinates and known-reference soft FG/BG labels. On pure-role packs0/3, a selected three-coordinate sign moment differs by2.000/1.913 between roles; this was selected using R labels and may merely repeat strong univariate channels. The availability observation does not establish extra joint information or query transfer.
cards.new_observation_or_argument: An eight-cell joint histogram can separate3-bit parity while univariate and pairwise histograms, means and covariance are identical. This is a finite nonfactorized decision, not an oracle label or new input. Need explicit quadratic control and a saturation/overfit negative. Novelty is not claimed.
algorithm: Compute min(8,D) channels with highest known-reference weighted role mean contrast divided by whole-reference standard deviation, ties lowest channel ID.
For each selected channel use the valid-reference weighted median as a fixed threshold; do not rank Q independently.
For each of56 three-channel tuples make an eight-cell role-balanced weighted FG/BG histogram with add-one smoothing per cell.
Select tuple maximizing known-reference balanced role posterior log likelihood gain over matched product-of-univariate role densities; lexical ties; no Q labels.
Use the selected tuple cell log density ratio log(pFG/pBG) as every Q token signed margin; no sigmoid/probability interpretation.
Emit full fixed>0 query mask through shared renderer. Empty FG/BG use common degenerate baseline; constant tuple odds produce0; invalid padding emits0.
cards.expected_benefit: synthetic_witness pending: resolve a same-low-moment target/distractor distinction that a quadratic decision cannot separate. In real DINO channels the source-selected tuple may be pure overfit; actual segmentation gain unknown.
cards.simplest_control: Raw FG cosine/prototype; selected channels univariate naive-Bayes; selected channels pairwise maximum-entropy/degree2 ridge cell features with the same add-one rule, same labels and same renderer. A degree3 polynomial fit is an additional control to expose whether histogram complexity alone matters.
cards.why_not_duplicate: Within-token feature-coordinate conjunction differs from reference pattern-response covariance, spatial3-token relation and continuous degree2 kernel. High-order parameter alone is not sufficient; counted only if complete discrete decision and its feature-space parity witness survive reviewer. It is one triple-code method, not56methods; cardinality/order/bin variants count0.
cards.counterexample: An unknown query style shift crosses reference coordinate thresholds; bins then change regardless of target identity. Selected channels may each already separate roles, leaving no joint information; 56-tuples on64rows can overfit reference. Orthogonal rotations destroy the fixed-coordinate parity.
cards.first_evidence: All eight equal-norm sign vertices of a3D cube, with role=sign-product: means/covariances match exactly and joint code must output all8 labels while degree2/univariate controls fail. Shift-threshold and missing-pattern negatives must expose vulnerability. Real4 full outputs and selected tuples are activity only; no quality scoring, no tuple tuning on Q.
cards.cpu_cost: O(Nr*D) channel statistics,56*8 source cell counts and O(Nq*3) selected-code evaluation; storage O((Nr+Nq)*D) input plus small histograms. One CPU thread. Feature selection and smoothing fixed; no exhaustive D choose3search.
cards.limitations: Coordinate dependent, sample selection bias and source overfit expected. Historical covariance/quadratic failure is not disproved by a parity toy. Ref-selected raw mean channels miss pure parity because every mean is equal; deterministic lowest-channel tie is part of witness and must be reported as a limitation. Failure reflection: report how much source logodds gain is joint versus univariate and how often Q cell support is unseen; do not relabel absent natural improvement as a high-order success.

evidence_levels.real_segmentation_gain: measured real native1024 four reused cases; no stable positive overall benefit
evidence_levels.synthetic_witness: measured constructed positive and counterexample; not natural quality

cards.probe_reflection: Three-bit parity separates from first/second order, but degree3 polynomial also succeeds. Exact global45-degree rotation merges coded cells and reduces histogram accuracy. Neither shows natural superiority or world originality.
cards.quality_claim_status: fixed version closed; do not expand200; keep callable negative method and failure evidence
